x: Pascoe, who has had a very successful season in Open Mile Handicaps, having gained a place in each one held, finished third just in front of Bryan. Thus on the running events the North were slightly in front on points, but our Field event men, led by D.
The South were without Fisher, and actually the North filled the first three places. In the Field Events the South missed D.

The latter gradually caught his man, but Ayton had sufficient left to beat our man down the home straight and so score the second of the Police track wins. In the Field Events the Police fared better aided by D.
The North won the 1 Mile Medley Relay and also the Team race held in connection with the 5 Miles Road Walk. In the Field Events the South made a better show and, aided by D.
We missed David Grigg's opposition in the Shot and Discus, but Brewer amply deputised for him. David reported that his foot, recently injured by an accident (a javelin), was progressing.
The Wandsworth team was captained by Dave Grigg, the English International, and in the 100 yards Ted Read was beaten by inches by Jackson of Herne Hill in 10.4 secs.
